fields.summary:
benign_pe.exe is a 64-bit MinGW-w64/GCC Windows PE fixture (SHA-256 dd4fc087aa16a9519990d49e2232c82d3f35630f7619bd9a677a263bde888531, image base 0x140000000, PE32+ amd64). It is a deliberately benign REA engine test fixture with essentially no malware behaviour. The only real program logic is a tiny main() at 0x140008590: it computes (argc*3+7), prints the format string "hello loadout %d\n" through a printf wrapper (0x1400025d0) that locks the stdout FILE, calls __mingw_pformat and unlocks, and returns (argc*3+7) & 1 as the exit status. It calls __main() first, which runs C global constructors once via __do_global_ctors (0x1400014d0) and registers the global-dtor iterator (0x140001480) with atexit. 

The rest of the 179 procedures are standard MinGW-w64 CRT startup/teardown, TLS, exception and PE-section boilerplate. Startup chain: mainCRTStartup (0x140001420) sets app type 0 and calls __tmainCRTStartup (0x140001010); WinMainCRTStartup (0x1400013f0) sets app type 1. __tmainCRTStartup spins on __native_startup_lock, runs _pei386_runtime_relocator (0x140001910), installs the unhandled-exception filter, initializes CRT state, copies argv, runs _initterm, calls __main, then main, then _cexit/exit. The runtime relocator and mark_section_writable (0x1400017a0) apply the GCC pseudo-relocation protocol using VirtualQuery/VirtualProtect; helper section routines (_FindPESection 0x1400021c0, _FindPESectionByName 0x140002210, __mingw_GetSectionForAddress 0x1400022c0, __mingw_GetSectionCount 0x140002340, _FindPESectionExec 0x140002380, _GetPEImageBase 0x140002400) locate image sections and the DOS/PE base. TLS callbacks tls_callback_0 (0x1400015b0) and tls_callback_1 (0x140001590) delegate to __mingw_TLScallback (0x140002070), which manages TLS key destructors through __mingwthr_run_key_dtors.part.0 (0x140001ec0) and ___w64_mingwthr_add/remove_key_dtor (0x140001f40/0x140001fd0). The SEH handler (0x140001cf0) maps Windows exception codes to signal() calls, and __mingw_raise_matherr/__mingw_setusermatherr (0x140001ca0/0x140001ce0) plus the default matherr printer (0x140001640) handle math errors. Runtime failure reporting (0x140001740) prints "Mingw-w64 runtime failure:" then aborts. __gcc_register_frame/__gcc_deregister_frame (0x140001460/0x140001470) and __tlregdtor (0x140001630) are no-op stubs.

Imports are only KERNEL32.dll (13 functions) and msvcrt.dll (32 functions); no network, registry, mutex or file I/O beyond stdout/stderr. Version resources identify it as "Loadout test fixture", "Benign REA engine fixture", product "loadout-rea-fixture", version 1.0.0.0, original filename "sample.exe"; a single 16x16 32-bit icon is present. GCC build strings "GCC: (GNU) 13-win32" and "GCC: (GNU) 15-win32" appear in .rdata. PE import hash is ec5fd56de1d2b0482abfc36f1d45317c. No IOC-like host/network indicators; the only distinctive strings are the hello format string and the resource metadata.
